summary: A stateless SPHINCS+-style binary hypertree without FORS. A 160-bit hash-derived index selects one leaf at each level. Level 0 reveals a 128-bit preimage; each of the remaining 159 two-leaf trees signs the previous root with 46 base-8 Winternitz chains. Verification rebuilds the final 128-bit public key.

facts.label: Signature layout
facts.value: 32 B randomizer + 32 B bottom proof + 159 × 752 B upper proofs = 119,632 B

facts.label: Path selection
facts.value: Low 160 bits of H(5, public key, message, randomizer); one bit per level

facts.label: WOTS encoding
facts.value: 128-bit root → 43 base-8 digits + 3 checksum digits; 46 chains, 7 steps each

facts.label: Upper proof
facts.value: 46 × 16 B chain values + one 16 B Merkle sibling

facts.label: Expansion
facts.value: Copies the signature to the witness; W = S = 119,632 B

profile.method: 10 accepting RISC-V runs; one fixed secret key, 10 distinct messages, SHA-256 test oracle
